svg.title: M-06 Split Driven-Element Mounting - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A driven-mount and hidden-gap witness method derived from O3-O6 Rev L.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3-O6 REV L
TWO ISOLATED HALVES ALONGSIDE ONE NONCONDUCTIVE SUPPORT.
DASHED ORANGE = FINAL TIES ONLY AFTER FEED-NODE DRILLING.
1 STATION TIE HOLDS BOTH HALVES AT EXITS; 2 SUPPORT-END TIES.
CENTER ST-2 AT ITS MARKED MIDPOINT; NO FORCED FIT; WITNESSES VISIBLE.
TWO ISOLATED TAPE HALVES; NO LONGITUDINAL SUPPORT.
DASHED ORANGE = FINAL STATION TIE AFTER FEED-NODE DRILLING.
ONE TIE CAPTURES BOTH HALVES AT THE HOLE EXITS; CLEAR NODES.
NO CRUSHING, CREASING, OR TWISTING; WITNESS LINES STAY VISIBLE.
DETAIL C | HIDDEN GAP / WITNESS METHOD
VIEW ALONG ELEMENT AXIS; PVC WALLS ARE THE MEASUREMENT SURFACES.
M-L / M-R: FROM EACH HIDDEN INNER TIP TO ITS OWN VISIBLE WITNESS LINE.
E-L / E-R: FROM THAT LINE TO THE ADJACENT OUTER PVC SURFACE.
HIDDEN TIPS ARE DASHED. DO NOT USE A LOOSE GAUGE INSIDE THE PIPE.
MEASURE / RECORD D, M-L, M-R, E-L, AND E-R WITH A CALIPER.
I-L = M-L - E-L I-R = M-R - E-R
SET EACH VISIBLE E TO ~0.500; RECALCULATE ACTUAL G.
G IS STEEL-TIP GAP, NOT FEED-SCREW CENTER SPACING.
STOP IF WITNESS READINGS ARE NOT REPEATABLE.
SPAN = MEASURED L + R + G; MEASURE INDEPENDENTLY; ALL SEPARATE LIMITS APPLY.
1. TEMP NONCONDUCTIVE HOLD; COLLINEAR / ISOLATED PRE-FEED.
2. DRILL FEED HOLES ONE HALF AT A TIME; REFIT AND RECALCULATE.
3. THEN FIT FINAL NONCONDUCTIVE TIES; CLEAR THE FEED NODES.
4. RECHECK G, SPAN, WITNESSES, AND DC ISOLATION.
IF A HALF MOVES AGAIN, CUT / REPLACE ITS LOCKING TIE.
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; FIGURES ARE SCHEMATIC EXCEPT ST-2 LENGTH AT 1:2.
2. USE APPROVED ACTUAL-MATERIAL 7/16 FIT; NO METAL MOUNTING TIES OR ADHESIVE.
3. FEED-NODE HOLE AND ELECTRICAL HARDWARE DETAILS ARE ON M-07 / O5 / O6.
